name: Flanagan's Pub

evidence.note: TripAdvisor review says the room is large enough for big bands and by 10:30 most people in the bar were dancing.
Pub's own page: 3rd Annual Oktoberfest, Sun Oct 4, 2-5 PM in the back parking lot, live music by Limewired.
Pub's events page shows live bands most Friday and Saturday nights.

dancing.notes: The main bar room is big enough that people dance when a party band plays. The Oct 4 Oktoberfest is outdoors in the back parking lot, with a band starting at 2 PM.

description: A family-run Irish-American pub and restaurant on Hawkins Avenue in Lake Ronkonkoma, with a long bar, a dining room, a private catering room and front and back patios. It has live music on Friday nights.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Ira's 'Flanagans Octoberfest' = the Oktoberfest at Flanagan's Pub in Lake Ronkonkoma (Limewired confirms on its own site). Not Lily Flanagan's in Babylon (now Lily's Babylon) or Father Flanagan's in Levittown.

Directory research 2026-10-04: No public email on the site (only a contact form). The home page says live music on Fridays; our old description said weekend nights, so a corrected description is offered. The Oktoberfest event is not on the venue site right now (it comes from our existing note citing Limewired's site), so it is left out of the description. Not the same as Lily Flanagan's (now Lily's Babylon) or Father Flanagan's.
